== Biography ==
Janet Smith was the wife of [[Glasgow-2822|Alexander Glasgow]]. The retained 1871 census extract records Janet Glasgow, aged 49, born at Galston, Ayrshire, as Alexander's wife in Bridgeton, Glasgow. Its approximate birth year remains about 1822.<ref name="Census1871">1871 Scotland Census, Janet Glasgow, wife of Alexander Glasgow, aged 49, Galston birthplace; Glasgow Bridgeton, registration 644/3, enumeration district 130, household schedule 6, line 24, roll CSSCT1871_130; retained extract and [https://search.ancestry.co.uk/cgi-bin/sse.dll?db=1871Scotland&indiv=try&h=4222004 Ancestry record 4222004]. Original census image not newly inspected for this review.</ref>

She is strongly identified with Janet Smith, aged 46, associated with Alexr Glasgow in the marriage index dated 23 April 1867. He was aged 54, widowed and a master flesher. The bride's name and age progression agree with the existing census wife and husband.<ref name="Civil1867">"Scotland, Civil Registration, 1855-1875, 1881, 1891", FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:6TPS-Q18Q : accessed 30 October 2026), Robert Glasgow in entry for Alexr Glasgow, 23 April 1867; displayed derivative marriage index, Alexr aged 54, widowed, master flesher; Janet Smith aged 46; Robert Glasgow and Margaret Brash Glasgow displayed as parents.</ref> An earlier marriage index, 30 April 1861, records Alexander as a widowed flesher aged 48 with Elizabeth Bicket, aged 42; it does not supply Elizabeth's death date.<ref name="Civil1861">"Scotland, Civil Registration, 1855-1875, 1881, 1891", FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:6TLR-J1JQ : accessed 30 October 2026), Robert Glasgow in entry for Alexr Glasgow, 30 April 1861; displayed derivative marriage index, Alexr aged 48, widowed, flesher; Elizabeth Bicket aged 42; Robert Glasgow and Margaret Brash Glasgow displayed as parents.</ref>

Alexander's 4 October 1875 death index at Rothesay records him as married, aged 62, a flesher, and lists Janet Smith under Other People. The occurrence fits this wife, but its display label alone does not explicitly state her role.<ref name="Civil1875">"Scotland, Civil Registration, 1855-1875, 1881, 1891", FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XSF1-N2WT : accessed 30 October 2026), Robert Glasgow in entry for Alexander Glasgow, 4 October 1875, Rothesay, Buteshire; Alexander aged 62, married, flesher; Robert Glasgow and Margaret Brash Glasgow displayed as father and mother; Janet Smith listed under Other People. Original image uninspected; access requires a FamilySearch centre or affiliate library.</ref> The named groom's parents are [[Glasgow-1538|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Brash-171|Margaret Brash]]; this does not identify Janet's own parents.

== Research Notes ==
=== Preserved identity link ===
The previous biography linked [[Glascoe-9|Jane  (Glascoe) Jordan (abt.1822-)]]. The reason for this link is unresolved. It is retained as research context, not an identification of Janet Smith with Jane Jordan, and does not justify a merger or natal-surname change.

=== Civil family review, 30 October 2026 ===
The civil sources are inspected derivative index displays; original marriage and death entries remain uninspected. Multiple person rows within one event are not independent sources. Samuel Smith and Janet Smith Smith appear under Other People in the 1867 display, but their exact roles must be checked before assigning Janet's parents. Retain her existing birth fields. The 1875 original requires a FamilySearch centre or affiliate library. Useful next checks are the bride's status, parental fields, residence and witnesses in the 1867 original, the death informant/spouse wording, and the original 1871 census.
